title: The spatial locus of common tangents to three disjoint convex sets is null
description: Self-contained proof that the union of complete affine lines actually meeting three pairwise disjoint arbitrary convex subsets of R3 and contained in a supporting plane of each has Lebesgue outer measure zero. Nonclosed, unbounded, lower-dimensional and nonsmooth sets are allowed. This proves Goaoc's 2008 Conjecture 4 measure-zero formulation, not Conjecture 3's countable-union-of-2-manifolds formulation. Supporting materials give exact formal and rational finite controls, not a continuum-proof oracle. Extensive AI assistance was used in solving, drafting and internal verification. This is an unrefereed preprint and has not undergone conventional external human peer review. A bounded documented literature audit found no prior resolution of the full statement; no first-proof or exhaustive-priority certificate is asserted.
